title: Managed Servers
description: Manage multiple Project Zomboid servers from one panel
noServersDesc: Start with one server. After it is active, dashboard, players, backups, mods, and remote actions come online.
addExistingServerDesc: Use this when server files already exist on this machine.
installNewServerDesc: Download via SteamCMD or create a Docker container — handles files, ports, passwords, and memory.
connectRemoteServerDesc: Use this for servers running on another machine through RCON.
step2Desc: Set it active and verify RCON
step3Desc: Return to Dashboard for live control
remoteServerDesc: RCON-only management is available for this server.
serverDisplayHelp: Label shown for this server throughout the panel's UI.
serverInternalIdentifier: Internal Project Zomboid server identifier used for its config and save folder names.
installPathLabel: Folder on disk where the server's Java/game files live.
zomboidDataPathHelp: Folder containing the server's save games, config, and logs.
customStartCommandHelp: Override the default startup script with a custom command.
rconHostHelp: Address the panel connects to for RCON commands.
rconPortHelp: TCP port the game server's RCON listener is on.
rconPasswordHelp: Password the panel uses to authenticate its RCON connection.
adminPasswordHelp: Server admin password passed as the -adminpassword launch argument.
gamePortHelp: UDP port players connect to in-game.
minMemoryHelp: Minimum heap size (-Xms) passed to the server's Java process.
maxMemoryHelp: Maximum heap size (-Xmx) passed to the server's Java process.
removeServerDesc: This will remove "{name}" from the panel.
deleteContainerDesc: Stops the container and permanently deletes this server's saves, config, and mods.
deleteBaseFilesDesc: Removes the shared PZ server installation (~3 GB).
willNotDelete: Server files will NOT be deleted — you can add this server back later.
steamUpdateDesc: Download the latest version using SteamCMD
steamVerifyDesc: Check and repair game files using SteamCMD
steamCmdPathHelp: Folder containing the SteamCMD executable used to download and update this server.
clearInstallFolderDesc: Deletes everything in the install path so you can reinstall from scratch. Use this if SteamCMD updates keep failing (stuck or corrupted download state) instead of fixing it manually.
steamBranchHelp: Steam branch/build to download or update to.
clearInstallConfirmDesc: This permanently deletes everything in {folder} — including the game files, SteamCMD's download state, and any mods installed there. Use this to recover from a SteamCMD update that keeps failing (corrupted or stuck installation). You'll need to run Start Update again afterward to reinstall from scratch. This does not affect your save data.
portMustBeBetween: RCON port must be between 1 and 65535
